parameters.name: DatasetMaxBindCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of bindings per dataset. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxEntityCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of metadata entities per dataset. Default value: 10000000000.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxFileCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of files per dataset. Valid values: 1 to 100000000. Default value: 100000000.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxRelationCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of metadata relationships per dataset. Default value: 100000000000.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxTotalFileSize
parameters.description: The maximum total file size per dataset, in bytes. After this limit is exceeded, no more indexes can be added. Default value: 90000000000000000.

parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description:
The dataset name. The name must be unique within the same project. The following naming rules apply:
- The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
- The name can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
- The name must start with a letter or an underscore (_).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the dataset. The description can be 1 to 256 characters in length. Default value: empty.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The workflow template ID. For more information, see [Workflow templates and operators](~~466304~~). Default value: empty.
